name: Vampire - Vampire Weaknesses - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a feature

results.text: A searing wave of holy fire consumes the vampire as it falters in the sun's glare.
Water's acidic kiss burns away flesh as the creature thrashes in futile defiance.
The stake shatters against an unseen barrier—its resting place remains inviolate.
A guest's refusal echoes like thunder, sealing the vampire out of sanctuary forever.
The threshold rejects its presence with a violent surge of arcane energy.
